_note: The plugin starts the MCP server through memo (run with bash: a git checkout of the plugin may not keep its executable bit). `memo mcp` reads the settings itself — the project's .luamemorc (found from the directory Claude Code starts it in, the project, upward) over ~/.luamemorc — so this entry needs no env and holds nothing secret. ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} points at the installed plugin directory. For a dev clone opened WITHOUT installing the plugin (so ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} is unset): claude mcp add luamemo -s local -- <repo>/cli/memo mcp
